78496.synopsis:

80288.synopsis:
We spent three years together in Ohio, living a simple yet respectful life. During his downhearted days, we took care of each other, supporting one another. Most of the time, it was me, a poor college student, looking after him and his children.
I’ve listened to him recount countless times the incidents where the Cheng family betrayed his kindness and integrity for personal gain… I also know all about how that wicked woman from the Cheng family toyed with his emotions but chose another partner for marriage.
He finally made it.
Ohio couldn’t hold him down. With a fresh influx of financing, he wiped away his past disgrace and resolved to take the children back to our home country. The night before returning, his dark eyes were particularly deep and affectionate. He swore, “I will organize a top-notch, luxurious wedding for you.”
My face was all smiles of contentment and reliance on him.
However, a dreadful dream surfaced in my mind. This man, who professed deep love and affection for me, would return to our home country and marry the vain Miss Cheng, whom he despised so much, in less than half a month.
Their story followed the clichéd script of reuniting after a breakup, falling in love after marriage, and the children playing matchmaker.
As for me, the insignificant supporting lady, I was just like Wang Baochuan1, accompanying him around low-end wholesale markets in the United States, buying heaps of cheap goods to save him money, a fool who hesitated to spend each dollar, converting it into Chinese yuan instead.
I could tolerate him choosing any woman for her wealth, but I never imagined he would stoop so low as to seek Cheng Shuangyi’s favor again.
How could Shen Qi do this?
He’s betraying not just me but also his impoverished, dirty past and the last shreds of conscience in a man.
That night, after packing his few belongings and discarding the rest marked by his presence, I left him with only one sentence, “Get lost, the farther the better.”
　[Small Theater]
After Shen Qi returned to the country, it was a time of revelry every night, a life of luxury and extravagance. Those who once looked down on him, who discarded him like worn-out shoes, suddenly reentered his world, seeking his forgiveness.
He thought he was the winner.
Yet, his heart felt hollow, and the image of that foolish woman often haunted his thoughts.
He never believed he truly loved her, considering it merely a complete exploitation. Yet, he couldn’t see genuine sincerity in anyone else but her.
Finally, when he heard news of her return, he went mad, ordering his two children to dress neatly and accompany him to the airport to welcome the woman who filled his eyes—
Yet, she walked past him indifferently.
As if their three years together had never existed.
[Most of the character names in this novel come from Langston Hughes’ poetry]
1: Wang Baochuan is a character from Chinese folklore and drama. She is known for her loyalty and devotion to her husband, General Xue Pinggui, in the story “The Legend of Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai” (also known as “The Butterfly Lovers”). In some adaptations, Wang Baochuan’s loyalty to her husband is exemplified by her waiting faithfully for him despite the passage of time and various challenges they face. The FL describes herself as similar to Wang Baochuan, suggesting that, like Wang Baochuan, she feels overlooked and undervalued in her relationship with her partner. The comparison serves to illustrate her feelings of insignificance and the imbalance in their relationship dynamic.
associated_names: 陪男主共度贫穷的女配觉醒了

81312.synopsis:
Mu Zhi’an transmigrated into a world of immortals and became a supporting character destined to be a stepping stone for the protagonist. 81824.synopsis:

Qing Jiu reflects, “Today I’ve found a seed, buried it in the soil, and nurtured it day and night with great care. Will a delicate flower bloom from it next year?”
In the depths of despair, Yu’er was given a helping hand. Qing Jiu’s arrival was the first ray of light piercing through her darkness, and since then, she has stayed by her side. 85152.synopsis:
In the dirtiest depths of the netherworld’s dungeon, I encountered the most malevolent demon in existence over millions of years.

He died ten thousand years ago and returned from Avīci Hell.

Under his protection, I entered the first immortal sect, advancing rapidly, and became the most outstanding genius among my peers.
He wanted me to take the sect master as my teacher, so I did; he wanted me to steal the supreme treasure, so I stole; he wanted me to compete for the head of the Daoist sect, so I contended…
Later, he wanted me to seduce and marry the sect master’s son.
I knew he wanted to destroy this immortal sect from its roots. When he gave the order, he leaned lazily against the bluestone under the moon, his white robe half-open, a cold and malicious smile amid his long, drooping hair.
This immortal sect with thousands of disciples was just a game he toyed with.
And I was just the ant he could use.
I knew it all.

I married.
Red bridal robe, candles, a grand human wedding.
I learned the ways of mortal women, feigned shyness and joy, and sat on the wedding bed waiting for my husband.

He wore a snow-white robe stained red, holding a long sword, blood trailing along his path, painting the ground red, the mountains behind him covered in blood.
He used the blood-stained sword tip to lift my red veil.
The cold blade kissed my throat.
I looked up and saw a pair of pitch-black eyes.
For the first time in the world, the demon shed two lines of bloody tears.
In a hoarse voice, he asked her.
“…How dare you.”

96160.synopsis:

97952.synopsis:
Su Jie, capable of traveling between Blue Star and the Cultivation World, discovered that cultivation was just too difficult.
Spirit Pills, Magic Artifacts, Pocket Worlds, and inherent comprehension—each was a mountain on the long road to immortality.
Not until Su Jie found out that Demon Cultivators refined corpses by killing, extracted souls to cultivate fiends, and used fear as sustenance for their cultivation.
Need souls to consecrate a Soul Summoning Banner? Get to know the pig farms that slaughter millions of pigs a year.

Years later.

Reward: Introduction to the Dao of Mountains and Rivers.]

101024.synopsis:
Yoo Raon, an ordinary art student and a Beta by nature, encounters a dangerous and menacing man one night while walking through a deserted alleyway.
“What should I do with someone so clueless, despite wanting to stay alive? Hmm?”

The two sat in a state-owned restaurant. Just as the slender yet handsome man across from her began introducing himself, Lu Qingyuan suddenly saw a strikingly red barrage of comments floating above his head.
At the same time, a cute mechanical voice rang in her mind, informing her that she had been bound to a system. Through this system, she could trigger pop-up comments, learn about the plot, and once she gained enough followers, she could even receive gifts from them!

But in this era, he comes from a dual-income household, has a bit of talent, and is quite good-looking. No wonder our clueless heroine doesn’t realize he’s all looks and no use.】

After reading the comments, Lu Qingyuan understood—she was the heroine of a melodramatic tragedy, and the man in front of her was the male lead. Whether the comments were true or not, Lu Qingyuan had no intention of taking this blind date any further.
Not long after, Lu Qingyuan successfully matched with Shu Beiqiu, a skilled technician at the machinery factory.
【Tsk, tsk, tsk, this guy really got his wish granted!】
【Well, in his past life, he’d rather stay single than stop protecting the heroine. My ship has finally sailed!】
【This devoted second male lead is the real deal! Finally, our heroine can live a blessed life!】
Seeing Lu Qingyuan blushing as she looked at him, Shu Beiqiu’s ears also turned red.

As it turned out, Lu Yanyan had been reborn. The first thing she did in this life was seduce the man who had once been her cousin’s husband. In her past life, Lu Qingyuan had lived in a grand townhouse in town, inherited her mother-in-law’s job, and eventually became the wealthiest businesswoman in the country!

……..
“Scholarship student.”
At the low call, Haewon turned around to face Kangwoo.
“I’m not a scholarship student anymore.”
That rebellious voice only sounded sweet to him. He had fallen, and fallen hard.
“Then what should I call you, Attorney?”
“No. I joined your company, Executive Director. I’m an employee now, so just call me casually.”
She said to call her casually, yet discomfort was written all over her face. Even that looked beautiful to him—was he completely hopeless?
“Does a title really matter? What matters is…”
As he lazily trailed off, closing the distance between them, Haewon took in a sharp breath.
He wanted to steal even that breath away.
“That you’ve come under me now.”
Once someone stepped into his domain, he never let them go.
Lee Haewon—would you be any exception?

108704.synopsis:
At three o’clock in the morning, Chu Hua was taken out of bed by her biological mother and was put into her elder brother’s official uniform.
Biological Father: “Your elder brother has gone to take care of matters for the emperor. In order not to attract attention, you will go to court on your elder brother’s behalf during this period. After going to court, hide in the corner obediently and don’t show your face or make any noise.”
Chu Hua:?
“I’m much shorter than my elder brother, have pierced ears, and my skin color is different…”
Mother took out a pair of thick-soled inner-height boots and powdered her face, ears, neck, and hands. She was extremely prepared.
Chu Hua: “…Is it necessary to commit the crime of deceiving the emperor?”
Father serenely looked over, “The Emperor allowed it.”
Chu Hua:? ?

114848.synopsis:
On the night of BH Group’s merger and acquisition party, Cha Yihyun ends up sleeping with his childhood friend Baek Juho, who had taken a rut inducer in his place.
For over ten years, Baek Juho had believed Yihyun to be a recessive Alpha, so Yihyun assumes that night would be the end of their relationship…
“Do you know who that Omega I slept with was?”
But Baek Juho doesn’t remember that it was Yihyun.
“I think that Omega from that day might be my, you know.”
“Your what?”
“My mate.”
***
“Cha Yihyun.”
Baek Juho leaned in close and whispered.
“You’re not doing a very good job controlling your pheromones. I can smell you.”
“Smell?”
“Yeah. The smell that turns me on.”
It’s only a matter of time before Yihyun’s secret is exposed.

115872.synopsis:
One day, former special agent Hwang Dae-heon ends up reading a novel titled “The Flower Garden of the S-Rank Guide” on the recommendation of a colleague—only to find himself suddenly possessed by the body of Hwang Seol-bin, a D-rank guide within the story.
Though Hwang Seol-bin was once close to the novel’s protagonist, the S-rank guide Kim Yong-ha, he is eventually ostracized by those around him due to his D-rank status and ultimately dies at the hands of a monster—just a disposable extra in the original plot.
Upon realizing who he has become, Hwang Dae-heon decides that the only way to return to reality is to follow the storyline of the original novel as closely as possible.
But was it a mistake to offer guidance to the villain Kang Biso during a chance encounter?
“…Hyung. I can’t give up. I’m going to come get you again.”
After that day, not only does Kang Biso—who was supposed to become obsessed with Kim Yong-ha—fixate on Hwang Seol-bin instead, but an item never mentioned in the original plot appears: the Book of Wishes.
Said to grant any wish, Hwang Seol-bin makes up his mind—he’ll gather the books and find his way back to reality…
“…I like you. Ever since the first time I saw you. I like you so much… I think I’m going crazy.”
Kang Biso, who desperately craves Hwang Seol-bin’s affection, and Hwang Seol-bin, who’s determined to find the Book of Wishes and return to his original world.
How will their story end?

117664.synopsis:
Song Yugui transmigrated into a book, becoming an early-death cannon fodder character with a penchant for other women. At home, she has the future main villain as her wife.
Although she has a penchant for other women, she is by no means a good person. She either beats or curses the wife she spent a fortune to marry, humiliating her daily and successfully pushing her into her villainous transformation. After scheming to kill the cannon fodder and becoming a widow, the villain begins to wantonly seduce the novel’s male lead, hoping he will rescue her from the mire. Unexpectedly, despite her many seductions, the male lead—who had been somewhat swayed—is stolen away by the female lead!
From then on, she resents the female lead, repeatedly causing trouble and not only affecting the main couple’s relationship but even trying to kill the female lead. When one of her plots fails and the female lead returns alive to expose her true nature, she is driven out of Songjia Village by the villagers and dies miserably on the streets on a cold night.
Song Yugui: …
Heavens, you really don’t see me as your own, do you? Giving me such a life-threatening setup right from the start!
At first, Song Yugui only wants to nurse the villain back to health, then give her a letter of divorce and let her marry the man she loves as she wishes. Unexpectedly… she tries too hard and ends up turning the villain gay!
Later,
On the dilapidated wooden bed, the future main villain wraps her long legs around the woman’s slender waist, sitting in her lap. Her pretty face is fierce as she interrogates her, “You glanced at the village belle one extra time just now. Do you have a crush on her? No! You’re not allowed! I’m better behaved and more obedient than her. You’re not allowed to like her!”
Song Yugui is utterly helpless. The main villain loves to cry, throw tantrums, and get moody. She threatens to “go dark” at the slightest disagreement. She can’t be beaten or scolded. What can she do?
She can only spend more time coaxing her and keeping her insecure, love-deprived villain-wife company.
Content Tags: Farming/Slice of Life, Female Side Character, Sweet Story, Transmigration into a Book, Daily Life, Marriage Before Love
associated_names: I’ll Raise Pigs to Support You

125600.synopsis:
Chu Zu was a novelist in his past life. He died from overworking himself to meet a deadline, pulling an all-nighter to finish his manuscript. After his death, he was bound to the “Marginal Character Correction System.” The system proposed a deal: if Chu Zu could successfully play the roles of hated side characters and “fix” them, he would be given a chance to live again.
Chu Zu: “So, I just have to tweak their personalities, right? That’s my specialty!”
First novel—
? Reader A: “You can dumb down a villain, but don’t expect your readers to be dumb too. Is that so hard to understand?”
? Same Reader A, later: “Holy shit, holy shit, HOLY SHIT! It was a mastermind’s scheme within a scheme within a SCHEME?! Grandpa Zu, I WAS WRONG! I SHOULDN’T HAVE SPOKEN SO LOUDLY!!!”
Second novel—
? Reader B: “Enough with this forced character setting. No matter how many times you repeat that he’s a ‘cute loyal dog,’ all I see is a bootlicker—a pathetic one that doesn’t even bark.”
? Same Reader B, later: “I TAKE IT BACK! He’s an invincible, sunshine-bright, loyal big dog! Where can I adopt one? A-ZU! LET ME RAISE YOU!!”
Third novel—
? Reader C: “Is the author’s life really that miserable? Do you have to create a character this venomous and unbearable? If you’ve hit a creative block, maybe just go get a real job?”
? Same Reader C, later: “F**K! LORD ZU, I’M SO SORRY! I’M AN UTTER FOOL!”
Fourth novel. Fifth. Sixth…
Chu Zu: So? My acting might be so-so, but I did a decent job fixing them, right?
System: [“…DO YOU EVEN KNOW WHAT A ‘SIDE CHARACTER’ IS?! HOW DOES TURNING THEM INTO MASSIVELY POPULAR FAN FAVORITES COUNT AS A SIDE CHARACTER?!”]
associated_names: A Novelist’s Guide for Side Characters to Survive

125856.synopsis:
It’s been 20 years since Gillen transmigrated into a child-rearing fantasy novel.
Now that he’s finally about to marry off his precious daughter Cecilia to the original male lead, he’s ready to retire and enjoy his second life in peace.
But an unexpected problem appears—
“Honestly, I wasn’t going to say this because you’re Cecilia’s father, but…”
“…?”
“I’m not interested in you, Duke.”
The problem?
The second male lead himself—Yuan.
Knowing all too well that Yuan’s personality is highly questionable, Gillen tries to remove him from his daughter’s life.
Yet before he realizes it, everyone starts thinking he’s just a creepy old man chasing after a guy 20 years younger than him.
To clean up the misunderstanding, he promises to stay away from Yuan for good.
“Thank you for the apology. I suppose this will be our final goodbye. Farewell.”
“…What? Final? What do you mean ‘final’?!”
But strangely enough, Yuan starts seeking Gillen out even more obsessively than before.
Dear Second Male Lead, why are you doing this to me, not my daughter…?

126368.synopsis:

His other name was Killian Clian Ridges, the ill-fated noble who lost both parents and his family to the betrayal of the very princess he was once engaged to.

Calliod assumed she was about to bite her tongue and end her life.
After creating all this tragedy, how dare she.
“Do you have any idea what it took to get here? Can I not claim at least one trophy that pleases me?”
Unlike before, Calliod now reached out with almost reverent care, wiping the blood from her face as if he were handling some precious treasure.
By then, the frozen blood had clotted thickly against his hand.

179616.synopsis:
On a dark, windy night, in Yan City, the notorious lowlife scoundrel Xue Bao Tian—an ironclad straight man in the world of flirtation—made one careless mistake and, in a muddle, got taken by someone. When he woke up, he was even slapped in the face with 200 yuan!

A tall and handsome migrant worker: “Can’t give you more. You’re not good-looking.”
Xue Bao Tian: “Screw your entire family.”
Xue Bao Tian is wealthy and powerful, cold-faced and black-hearted. He has never failed in revenge—until he runs into this migrant worker, where he keeps hitting a wall. Every attempt ends in failure, and every time he somehow delivers himself right back into the wolf’s den.

Construction site supervisor: “I don’t know the person you’re talking about. Never worked here.”
Xue Bao Tian: “Isn’t it said that a big forest has all kinds of birds? So why is it that with me—there’s ‘no such bird’?!”
